subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish descriptor-scoped sessionActions and allowChatNavigation as a supported long-term plugin API for sandboxed external tabs?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin capability rather than a repair to an established contract, and the supplied discussion contains no feature-owner approval for its permanent scope.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow bridge
options.body: Approve the scoped action and navigation contract after the Gateway-derived context repair and exact-head browser proof are supplied.

options.title: Keep tabs read-only
options.body: Retain the existing GET/HEAD sandbox grant and ask plugin authors to use existing authenticated parent or bearer surfaces outside opaque frames.

options.title: Design a different plugin API
options.body: Pause this PR while the feature owner defines a durable capability model that does not expose parallel session-action semantics.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow bridge
recommendation.body: Approve the scoped action and navigation contract after the Gateway-derived context repair and exact-head browser proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the merged sandboxed-tab security and Control UI boundary this PR extends.
